notablePrerequisites:
Nature's Embrace attached to Order of Whiteclay.
Order of Whiteclay does not have summoning sickness.
You have a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
description:
Activate Order of Whiteclay by tapping it, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Order of Whiteclay by paying {1}{W}{W} and untapping it, returning a creature card with mana value three or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
